game.title: Arizona Cardinals at Los Angeles Chargers

lede: Arizona Cardinals carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#18 in EPA per play), while Los Angeles Chargers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#4 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Los Angeles Chargers -4.9 with a fair total of 45.3 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Arizona Cardinals pass offence vs Los Angeles Chargers pass defence, which sits −0.116 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
